name: REPORT_SNAPSHOT_V1
snapshot_boundary: open one LLD-01 stable read Snapshot after report attempt/as_of/scope is committed
resolve report period boundaries in fixed America/Guayaquil and keep as_of_utc constant for every contributor/calculation
enumerate Customer scope by immutable Customer Organization id; all/specific/unassigned semantics are supplied by the relevant section contract and never by display-name matching
build SLA member and cohort rows from accepted SR/classification/current-policy/source evidence using INDIVIDUAL_SLA_V1 and COHORT_STATE_V1 at that exact as_of_utc

invoke the closed ReportSectionContributor registry in deterministic section order for any non-SLA report sections owned by other LLDs; each contributor reads only through the same stable Snapshot and emits only its versioned bounded snapshot contract

while the read Snapshot remains open, persist emitted rows in ordered bounded staging batches through a separate LLD-01 writer connection; the read Snapshot never observes those new staging rows and therefore remains one consistent accepted-state view
after every contributor reaches complete EOF, compute exact member/section/cohort counts and canonical snapshot SHA-256 over report request metadata plus ordered normalized staged semantic rows
SealReportSnapshot re-derives count/hash from persisted staging and marks ready_to_generate; only then close/release the stable read boundary if not already released by framework finalizer
canonical_hashing: UTF-8 canonical JSON tokens with explicit schema/version/kind identities; no locale-dependent formatting
order SLA member snapshots by immutable service_request_id after report-defined presentation ordinal is separately captured; order tier/cohort rows by canonical IDs/key tuple
order cross-domain sections by closed registry ordinal then contributor-provided canonical row key
exclude artifact filesystem metadata, temporary paths and generated XLSX packaging from snapshot identity
artifact_generation: writer opens no live domain queries; it reads sealed staged rows only
render exact period/timezone/scope, included/excluded/unclassified/uncalculable populations, SLA policy revisions and represented cross-domain sections
write authoritative results as literal values rather than spreadsheet formulas whose later recalculation could change meaning
close artifact then reopen/validate required sheets/row totals/snapshot identifier and calculate file SHA-256/byte size
only a VALID verification may transition attempt to completed and thereby make staged snapshot rows immutable historical evidence
failure_cleanup: before completed transition all staging children are technical attempt data and may be deleted by governed failure/cancellation cleanup
failed/cancelled attempt retains bounded state/failure/audit/job metadata, not the full staged operational population
completed rows are never cleaned because live data/policy later changes, terminal status, source age, report age or external artifact movement
temporary candidate file cleanup is filesystem housekeeping and never operational-history cleanup authority
rules: Daily/Weekly/selected-range reports show as-of progress for canonical monthly SLA cohorts rather than redefining contractual cohort boundaries
report-time descriptive Customer/Contact/status/summary values are captured only when a registered section schema actually renders or requires them
complete source observations, communications bodies, Working Notes, discarded Product and unrelated personal data are forbidden from snapshot payloads
a report may be scoped to one Customer Organization or all Customers; completed evidence always freezes exact scope and timezone
